title: Legs & Core
description: Unilateral legs and complete core work: pulse squats, good mornings and side planks

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.instructions: Run in place, heels toward the glutes

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate arched and rounded back, breathe

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: Pulse squats
exercises.instructions: Stay at the bottom of the squat, small up-down pulses

exercises.name: Reverse lunges
exercises.instructions: Big step backward, lower the knee

exercises.name: Single-leg deadlift
exercises.instructions: Hinge the torso, one leg lifts behind, keep your balance

exercises.name: Good morning
exercises.instructions: Hands behind the head, hinge the torso forward, back straight

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.instructions: On one forearm, body aligned, hips high

exercises.name: Scissors
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, legs extended, cross them alternating over/under

exercises.name: Shoulder tap plank
exercises.instructions: In a high plank, tap the opposite shoulder alternating

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, arms and legs up, extend opposite arm/leg alternating

exercises.name: Hip flexor stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply
